summary.tldr: Lowers the federal voting age in Canada from 18 to 16 and updates election rules for younger voters.
what_it_does: Lowers the voting age in the Canada Elections Act, so Canadian citizens who are 16 or older on polling day can vote federally.
Redefines “future elector” as a Canadian citizen who is 14 or 15 years old.
Repeals subsection 22(5) of the Canada Elections Act.
Updates rules in sections 281.3 and 549.1 so they refer to people who are 16 or older, or will be 16, on polling day.
summary.background: The bill amends the Canada Elections Act. Its stated purpose is to lower the federal voting age in Canada from 18 to 16 years of age.
